trap.label: hardly ever
trap.wrong: Hardly ever a deal succeeds without research.
trap.right: Hardly ever does a deal succeed without research.
trap.why: Em português a ordem “raramente um acordo funciona” é direta. Em inglês, após hardly ever no início usa-se do/does.

mcq.q: Hardly ever ___ a deal succeed without research.

fix.right: Hardly ever does a deal succeed.

rewrite.prompt: Comece com Hardly ever: “A deal hardly ever succeeds.”
rewrite.answer: Hardly ever does a deal succeed.

rewrite.prompt: Comece com Only then: “Rui understood then.”
Comece com Hardly ever: “They hardly ever agree.”
